title: Cross-account constrained role templates: TF module for service identities in Private VPC
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that codifies cross-account role templates and constrained trust relationships for Private (VPC) deployments. The module should enable: 1) creating least-privilege role templates for service identities (e.g., inference runtime, autoscaler, metrics-shipper), 2) establishing secure, auditable cross-account trust with explicit external account allow-lists and conditionals (OIDC or STS), and 3) exposing outputs that map logical service names to role ARNs for downstream stacks. This is intended to replace ad-hoc role creation patterns and provide a migration path from the existing binding factory and policy generator artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Module publishes to internal Terraform registry with semantic versioning and README describing variables and outputs
Least-privilege role templates implemented for at least three Redwood service identities with CI validation tests that exercise deny/allow scenarios
Cross-account trust is configurable via allow-list variables and enforced by Terraform (no wildcard principals by default)
Module provides idempotent migration helpers: a mapping from legacy binding resources to new role ARNs and a documented smoke-test plan
Security review completed and signed off; automated policy linting (tfsec/custom rules) passes in pipeline
implementation_notes: Inputs: service_templates (map), trust_accounts (list), oidc_providers (list), managed_policy_arns (map), env_tag (string)
Outputs: role_arn_map (map of service_key -> role_arn), role_names (list), migration_report_url (string)
Role template pattern: assume_role_policy constructed from template variables to avoid terraform interpolation drift; enforce explicit conditions (audience, external_id) where possible
Provide a small helper script `scripts/migrate_bindings_to_roles.sh` that queries legacy binding state and emits a suggested tfvars mapping; include dry-run and apply modes
Testing: Terratest + local AWS account sandbox to validate assume-role flows and confirm attached policies only allow expected API calls
CI: require policies to pass custom checks for 'NotResource:*' anti-patterns and ensure no '*' actions on iam:PassRole or kms:Decrypt in service roles
Backward compatibility: add a legacy_compat flag to create shim role_mappings outputs for stacks that still read legacy binding names
Upgrade path: recommend a three-week phased rollout per env: create roles (no-attach), update services to use new role_arns via config, remove legacy binding resources
Observability: emit CloudTrail event filters and a simple Lambda-based health-check that flags failed AssumeRole calls; provide a dashboard link in README
